name: AgentixHub Chat
author: agentixhub

sections.description:
AgentixHub Chat connects your WordPress site to an AI agent you build on AgentixHub. Visitors click the chat button, and your agent answers by text or by voice, any time of day.

You don’t need to write code. Copy your workflow link from AgentixHub, paste it into the plugin, and choose where the chat should appear.

What you can use it for

  • Answer customer support questions before they become tickets
  • Qualify leads and collect contact details
  • Book appointments and guide visitors to the right page
  • Talk to visitors by voice or video, not only text
  • Talk to visitors in their own language, with full right-to-left support

A chat widget that looks like part of your site

Pick your brand colour and the plugin works out readable text colours for you. Choose a round button, a button with a label, or a side tab. Use one of the built-in icons or upload your own. Add a tooltip, a notification dot or a gentle attention animation.

The chat window has a light and dark mode, and can follow the visitor’s device setting. On phones it can open full screen, and it handles notches and the on-screen keyboard. Every change shows up in a live preview before you save.

Show it where it matters

  • Floating chat button on every page, or only on the pages you pick
  • Rules by page type, post type, URL, device, logged-in status and user role
  • AgentixHub Chat block for the block editor
  • Classic widget for sidebar themes
  • [agentix_chat] shortcode to embed the chat in a page or show a button
  • Open the chat from any menu item or link that points to #agentix-chat

Ways to start the conversation

  • Open the chat after a few seconds, or once the visitor scrolls down the page
  • Show a short teaser message next to the button
  • Set business hours in your site’s timezone, with an offline message outside them

Privacy and consent

You can ask visitors to accept your Privacy Policy before the chat loads. Until they agree, nothing is loaded from AgentixHub. Test mode lets you try everything while only administrators can see the chat.

Works with your existing setup

The chat runs in the visitor’s browser and makes no requests to your server, so page caching keeps working. WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache and Autoptimize are configured for you. Texts can be translated with Polylang or WPML.

For developers

  • JavaScript API: AgentixChat.open(), AgentixChat.close(), AgentixChat.toggle()
  • Browser events: agentix:open, agentix:close, agentix:workflow_loaded
  • Filters: agentix_chat_should_display, agentix_chat_client_config
  • Set AGENTIX_CHAT_WORKFLOW_URL in wp-config.php to keep the link out of the database
  • Settings export and import

External services

This plugin shows a workflow hosted on the AgentixHub platform. Nothing is loaded from AgentixHub until an administrator saves a workflow link.

By default, the visitor’s browser loads the workflow link from the AgentixHub server only when the visitor first opens the chat. If the administrator sets Connection → Load the workflow to “After the page has loaded”, the browser loads it in the background inside a hidden frame once the page has finished loading, so the chat opens instantly. If you turn on the consent option, loading waits until the visitor agrees. The live preview on the plugin’s settings screen in wp-admin also loads the workflow, in the administrator’s browser. Anything the visitor types, says or enters in the chat is sent to AgentixHub. The plugin adds the colour scheme and page language to the link. If you set up Extra URL parameters, the values you choose (for example the page address or a logged-in user’s name) are added as well.

  • Service: agentixhub.ai
  • Terms of Service: agentixhub.ai/terms-of-service
  • Privacy Policy: agentixhub.ai/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New, search for “AgentixHub Chat” and click Install Now, then Activate.
  2. Open AgentixHub Chat in the admin menu.
  3. Paste the workflow link from your AgentixHub control panel and save.
  4. Leave the plugin in Test mode while you set up the button, chat window and display rules. Only administrators see the chat in Test mode.
  5. Switch to Live when you’re happy with it.
sections.faq:
Do I need an AgentixHub account?

Yes. The plugin shows an AI agent that you build and run on AgentixHub. Visit agentixhub.ai or email support@agentixhub.ai to get started.

Where do I find my workflow link?

In the AgentixHub control panel, open your workflow and copy its access link. It contains /run/.

Can the chatbot talk to visitors by voice?

Yes, if your AgentixHub workflow uses a voice or video agent. The browser asks the visitor for microphone permission the first time.

Does the chatbot work in other languages and on right-to-left sites?

Yes. You set up your agent’s languages and behaviour in AgentixHub. The plugin tells the agent which language the page is in, the chat window flips for right-to-left languages, and every text visitors see can be translated.

Will it slow down my site?

No. The chat script is small and loads after the page. By default the agent loads only when a visitor first opens the chat. If you choose After the page has loaded, it loads in the background once the page is idle, so it doesn’t hold up your content.

Does it work with page caching plugins?

Yes. Display rules for devices and business hours run in the browser, so cached pages still behave correctly.

Can I show the chat inside a page instead of a floating button?

Yes. Use the AgentixHub Chat block, the classic widget or the [agentix_chat] shortcode. To hide the floating button, set Display Rules → Show the floating launcher to “Nowhere (embed only)”.

Is the workflow link private?

No. The workflow link works like a public launch link: visitors’ browsers load it to start the chat. Settings exports do not include it, so after importing settings on another site, paste the workflow link there once.

Does the plugin add links or credits to my site?

No. A small “Powered by AgentixHub” link in the chat header appears only if you turn it on under Chat Window.

Can I change the look beyond the built-in options?

Yes, with WordPress’s own Additional CSS (in the Customizer, or under Styles in the Site Editor). The chat exposes these parts: launcher, panel, header, frame and teaser. For the floating chat, use for example #agentix-chat-root::part(launcher) { box-shadow: none; }. For a chat placed with the block, widget or shortcode, use .agentix-chat-embed::part(panel).
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Added the plugin icon and banner.
  • Removed the Custom CSS setting. To restyle the chat beyond the built-in options, use WordPress’s Additional CSS with the parts listed in the FAQ.

1.0.2

  • The “Open in new window” button is now off by default.
  • “Hide other chat buttons and cookie bars on phones” is now off by default; turn it on under Chat Window.
  • Fix: on iPhone and iPad, tapping a field in the chat no longer zooms the page and pushes the chat window out of place.
  • Fix: on iPhone, the full-screen chat stays lined up with the visible screen when the keyboard opens, instead of sliding up and showing the page underneath.
  • Fix: an unrecognised saved mode now falls back to Test instead of Live.

1.0.1

  • The workflow now loads when a visitor first opens the chat. Change it under Connection → Load the workflow.
  • The workflow frame gets fewer permissions by default (microphone, autoplay, clipboard, full screen). The list is editable under Connection.
  • New: on phones, optionally hide other chat buttons and cookie bars while the chat is open.
  • Settings exports no longer include the workflow link.
  • Fix: the chat button could stay unresponsive on sites that delay JavaScript, such as WP Rocket’s “Delay JavaScript execution”.

1.0.0

  • First release.
  • Embed your AgentixHub workflow in a chat window you can fully customise.
  • Display rules, business hours, consent before loading, block, classic widget and shortcode.
  • Right-to-left support, translatable texts, settings export and import.
  • Suggested privacy policy text.
